gloss: to turn face down, to hide, to conceal

definitions.gloss: to turn face down, to lay something face down
definitions.explanation: To place something with its open or front side facing downward.

definitions.gloss: to hide, to conceal, to keep secret
definitions.explanation: To deliberately withhold information or keep something out of sight.

examples.japanese: コップを{伏|ふ}せて{乾|かわ}かす。
examples.english: Turn the cup upside down and let it dry.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{終|お}わったら{茶碗|ちゃわん}を{伏|ふ}せておいてください。
examples.english: When you're done eating, please turn your bowl upside down.

examples.japanese: {事実|じじつ}を{伏|ふ}せて{報告|ほうこく}した。
examples.english: The report was made with the facts concealed.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}は{伏|ふ}せたまま{記事|きじ}が{公開|こうかい}された。
examples.english: The article was published with the names of those involved kept secret.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{目|め}を{伏|ふ}せる (cast one's eyes down)
・カードを{伏|ふ}せる (turn a card face down)
・{名前|なまえ}を{伏|ふ}せる (withhold a name)
・{事実|じじつ}を{伏|ふ}せる (conceal a fact)

The sense 1 meaning (turning face down) often appears in instructions or descriptions of physical actions. The sense 2 meaning (concealing) is frequently used in news reporting and formal writing.
